Sept. 8 Joyn Kazanjian - 25 - cong. eye inflamation - 2 months Anna Vanbel - 50 - of Dayton, O. - kidney complication. .
Page 153 Sept. 13 Marylin Kramer - 4 - infint. paralysis feared. .. . quite ill .... John Thoma + 33 dround last Sunday a.m. Wife and friends still looking for body ....
Ella - Law - 36 - trained nurse
13 6th Martin Moran - 63 - cancer-like jaw and mouth . . improving
Elizabeth Rooks - 30 - something like cancer on breast Mrs. Fran Bowers - 50 - of Pinkney, Mich. - intestinal cancer. Joseph Bresbine - Cincinnati - 45-50 - abuses wife - friends fear ... Emmett Richardson - 45 - internal cancer feared .. ...
15
16th Thanks - Laura M. Palmer - 67 - had been given up for intestinal can- cer but sader than cancer, married out of the Church - had been 40 years away from confession ..... Enrolled in Ser. Mass Ass'n and prayed for. Went to confession and comm'n. Operated on Tuesday after Thanks giving last; is here To-day 100%. Deo Gr .!
Page 154 Sept. 16 Rita Martin - 18 - Ecsema ... since small child .. . Mrs. Anna Arthier - 61 - slight stroke
Mrs. Mary Bailey - over 70 - very peculiar neck-gland, swolen inside of a week - look threatening ...
Thanks - Frederick Griffith of Hamilton, Ont. - 55 - Convert - lu- kemia - Had never received Holy Communion in 25 yrs. Sick since last April and for some time with 103 fever. Enrolled last Wednesday and since that fever has vanished - received Communion last Sunday. Quite a number of his relatives have no religion or faith ..... It is Hoped now that possibly a miracle. . . They take No. II City of God
